verdict.line: You lose extended trades level 1-5 if you walk up into his Q range, but you win the lane and the 1v1 once you can land a cleanse-proof knockup.

brief.thesis: Gangplank's Q (Parrrley, 625 range, 5s cooldown) plus his passive Grog-Soaked Blade poison let him win ranged poke exchanges before Ornn can close distance, which is why OP.GG gives him lane advantage despite Ornn holding the overall 51.2% head-to-head over 1586 games. The counter is structural: his W (Remove Scurvy) clears stuns but explicitly does not clear airborne, so Ornn's E (Searing Charge) terrain shockwave and R (Call of the Forge God) recast both knock up through his cleanse, which is the real reason Ornn holds the solo-kill edge.

theirWindow.when: you approach minions with his Q up
theirWindow.what: He fires Parrrley for free poke damage plus Grog-Soaked Blade poison on any follow-up auto. Do not walk up to last-hit under his 625 range until his Q is on cooldown, especially levels 1-5 when you have no answer at range.

yourWindow.what: Remove Scurvy only clears stuns, not airborne, so time your all-in around it being on cooldown (18-22s) or already spent. Land E into a wall for the shockwave knockup, or land R and recast into him — both ignore his cleanse entirely.

start.why: 73.2% pick rate at 50.8% win rate because the regen and damage reduction from blocking autos directly offsets his poison-and-poke harass pattern.

boots.why: 83% pick rate at 52% win rate — Gangplank's damage comes from autos carrying Grog-Soaked Blade poison, and Steelcaps flatten that basic-attack chip damage all lane.

core.why: Immolate punishes him for standing in melee range and gives you the resist stacking to start winning extended fights.
Directly punishes the auto-attack reliance that defines his poke-and-poison pattern (47.6% win rate over 63 games on this path).
Stacks with your passive's bonus resists for the late-game tank threshold his auto-reset damage can't break through.

situational.when: he builds crit or attack speed items to scale his auto-poison damage faster
their team has more magic damage threats than Gangplank's own physical poison

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustain-per-proc directly answers a lane defined by ranged poke and passive poison chip rather than burst.

summoners.why: Teleport is the dominant pick at 72.1% and lets you reset after absorbing poke without losing CS or tempo; Flash is mandatory to close the gap for your E/R knockup windows.

playing.title: Don't contest CS under his Q
playing.detail: His Parrrley has a 5s cooldown and 625 range, so he can poke every wave. Only step up to last-hit when his Q is visibly on cooldown.

playing.title: Save E for a wall, not open ground
playing.detail: Searing Charge only knocks up if you collide with terrain mid-charge. A flat-ground E is just a damage poke, not an engage.

playing.title: Track his Remove Scurvy timer
playing.detail: It clears stuns and heals him but does nothing against airborne. All-in when it's down, and commit to the knockup chain rather than a slow or root he can cleanse away.

playing.title: Use R to force the all-in, not to poke
playing.detail: Call of the Forge God's recast knockup is the one CC in your kit his W cannot answer. Land the elemental, then recast into him immediately.

playing.title: Hold Teleport for tempo, not just saves
playing.detail: Since he wins the poke war early, use Teleport to return to lane with full resources after a bad trade rather than losing CS sitting under tower.

playing.title: Respect his E (Raise Morale) before team fights
playing.detail: It buffs nearby allied AD and movement speed on a 20s cooldown, so expect him to hit harder and catch up faster right after he fires it near allies.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, and win-rate figures are measured OP.GG data from live games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning about cleanse-proof knockups and poke timing is this brief's own analysis, not sourced from OP.GG.

stats.opponentTip: Gangplank’s (W) cleanses CC skills such as stuns but not airborne. Get rid of his (E) yourself and retreat quickly if you failed, and close in only when going in for a ceratin kill.
